content.text: In regions where payment processors like Stripe or PayPal are blocked, digital creators face substantial barriers to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-nowpayments-webhooks-cloudflare-workers-step-step-21|COREMERCH guide to setting]] up an online store. This challenge is particularly acute in countries like Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela, where conventional payment platforms simply do not operate. COREMERCH offers two architectures to enable creators to establish their digital stores: Stack 01, which utilizes GitHub Pages, and Stack 02, which employs [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-22|Cloudflare R2]] Pages. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-lemon-squeezy-alternatives-restricted-countries-plain-language-5|understanding]] the strengths and weaknesses of these deployment options is crucial for anyone looking to build a sustainable digital commerce solution without relying on restricted platforms.
What Each Option Actually Offers

Stack 01, built on GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, enables deployment within 4-6 hours. This stack is ideal for creators who need a straightforward setup with minimal complexity. It allows for quick access to a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing via NOWPayments. On the other hand, Stack 02 leverages Cloudflare Pages and Workers combined with Supabase, providing a more robust infrastructure that supports scalability and additional features. Deployed by COREMERCH in just 48 hours, it includes end-to-end testing and configuration of SPF/DKIM/DMARC for enhanced email deliverability, making it a stronger choice for creators with a diverse range of products.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Both Stack 01 and Stack 02 are designed to cater to creators in countries where traditional payment systems are unavailable. Stack 01's reliance on GitHub Pages makes it accessible for those familiar with basic web development, offering a straightforward solution for quick deployment. However, Stack 02’s architecture is better suited for creators who may face more complex needs or expect to grow their product offerings over time. With built-in scalability and support for 5 products, Stack 02 is particularly valuable for creators in regions like Zimbabwe or Cameroon, where infrastructure reliability is critical.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, both stacks utilize NOWPayments for crypto transactions, which charge a minimal fee of 0.5% on successful payments. However, the speed of deployment varies, with Stack 01 allowing creators to start accepting payments within hours, whereas Stack 02 takes longer for full deployment but ensures a tested and more reliable backend. In markets where transaction costs are a major concern, both options keep fees low through the use of recommended networks like BSC and TRON, ensuring that creators retain maximum revenue from their sales.
Stack 02 provides a tested infrastructure, reducing deployment headaches.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

A key advantage of both architectures is the full ownership creators maintain over their digital stores post-deployment. Unlike other platforms that may impose ongoing fees or restrict access to data, COREMERCH ensures that customers own everything outright. Stack 01 provides a more manual approach to product delivery, relying on Google Drive for file storage, while Stack 02 automates much of the backend logic with Supabase, making it easier for creators to manage their products and orders seamlessly.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For those who need to get started quickly and have a limited number of products, Stack 01 is an excellent entry point. It allows for rapid deployment and testing to validate market ideas. However, for creators anticipating growth or needing more sophisticated functionality, Stack 02 is the superior choice. It provides a more comprehensive solution that can adapt as their business evolves, thanks to its end-to-end testing and advanced features.

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, you can utilize Stack 01 or Stack 02 from COREMERCH. Stack 01 offers rapid deployment through GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, while Stack 02 leverages Cloudflare Pages and Workers for a more robust and scalable solution. Both stacks allow you to receive payments in various cryptocurrencies without the need for traditional payment processors.
Ownership means you control your data and profits, no strings attached.

Begin by selecting the stack that fits your needs—either Stack 01 or Stack 02. Next, follow the deployment steps outlined in the Sovereign Blueprint. Deploy the backend first using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Configure the payment layer with NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing. Test your setup on the mainnet to ensure everything works correctly. Once confirmed, promote your digital products through social media and other channels.
